subject: Request: Vendor portal onboarding & temporary no-PO path for Atlas Financial pilot
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@atlasfin.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlasfin.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding for pilot — PO question

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this week. Atlas is excited to run the 3-month pilot of Redwood’s dedicated inference offering. Our procurement team is starting vendor setup but flagged that Atlas requires a PO for all purchases.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood accept a PO for the pilot invoices, or do we need to go through an exception process? The pilot is billed monthly and will be under $7k/mo.
- If a PO is required, can you share the vendor onboarding packet and any specific tax/contracting details your team needs?

I’ve attached our standard onboarding form for your intake team. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Sara Liu
Head of Vendor Ops, Atlas Financial
attachments: atlas_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@atlasfin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding for pilot — PO question

Hi Sara — great to hear.

Short answers: we can accept a PO but our standard onboarding route prefers invoices routed through our Vendor Portal which ties into our PO matching. We do have a temporary exceptions flow for pilots < $10k/month to avoid blocking time-sensitive trials, but it requires sign-off from Finance and Procurement.

Next steps I suggest (low friction):
1) I’ll kick off intake with our vendor team using your onboarding form — attaching the SOW draft we discussed.
2) Finance (Laura) can confirm whether a temporary no-PO path can be granted for the pilot and for what duration.
3) If approved, we’ll provision Atlas in the vendor portal with a billing alias and provide an invoice routing address so you can submit monthly invoices without a PO.

If that works, I’ll start step 1 now.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding for pilot — PO question

Vanessa — thanks for the heads-up and clear plan. A few policy notes from Finance:

- Temporary no-PO exceptions are allowed for pilots up to 90 days and <$10k/month, provided we have:
  * Completed vendor onboarding form (tax ID + W8/W9 where applicable)
  * Signed SOW or purchase confirmation (DocuSign link acceptable)
  * A named internal owner and a plan for converting to PO-based billing if the pilot converts to paid production

- For Atlas specifically: their onboarding form is missing the W9 field and the primary AP contact. Monica, can you confirm we have the right tax info and that vendor portal provisioning will capture an AP email?

- If Procurement (Aditya) signs off, Finance will issue an exception approval email and set up a one-time billing alias for the pilot invoices; operations will still require monthly invoice PDFs to match to the alias.

I’m happy to approve the exception once Procurement confirms risk/contract alignment.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding for pilot — PO question

Team — reviewed the request and attachments. Notes:

- Legal has reviewed the SOW-Atlas-Pilot-v1.docx and there are no material terms that would prevent a pilot exception. We flagged a short clause around data retention that we’ll track in the pilot review but it doesn't block onboarding.
- Risk assessment: low for a three-month pilot with capped spend <$10k/mo.
- Approval: Procurement approves a temporary no-PO exception for Atlas for the pilot period 2027-07-01 through 2027-09-30, conditional on:
  1) Completed onboarding form with tax ID or W-8/W-9 attached;
  2) Signed SOW via DocuSign (link received) or equivalent signed confirmation;
  3) Atlas agrees to convert to standard PO-based billing within 30 days of pilot conversion to production.

Vanessa — please confirm Atlas sends the missing tax info and that you’ll update HubSpot deal ATL-2027-PILOT-091 with the exception details and DocuSign link. Laura, once the onboarding form and DocuSign are in our records, can Finance issue the exception email and provisioning?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOW-Atlas-Pilot-v1.docx (docx), internal_risk_note.txt (txt)
